SI-4.answer: Dissecting Heterogeneity in Functional Network Connectivity Aberrations in Antipsychotic Medication-Naïve First Episode Psychosis Patients - A Normative Modeling Study

NM2-1.detail: Predictive Clinical Neuroscience (PCN) toolkit (version 0.27) used. Specific algorithm (e.g., BLR, GPR) not explicitly stated in the text, but PCN toolkit is specified.
NM2-1.supporting_text: Here, we used the Predictive Clinical Neuroscience (PCN) toolkit (version 0.27), a publicly available Python package, for normative modeling of resting state connectivity data.

NM2-2.detail: Resting-state functional connectivity using the Yeo-17 functional network parcellation atlas, resulting in 136 connectivity values.
NM2-2.supporting_text: Individual-level patterns of deviations from a normative reference range in resting-state functional networks using the Yeo-17 atlas for parcellations. ... resulting in a functional connectivity matrix of 136 connectivity values.
NM2-2.location: Thukral2024.pdf.md: Abstract / Main Outcome(s) and Measure(s); Methods / Image processing

NM2-3.detail: Age is implied by 'across the lifespan (age range (yrs): 2-100)'. Site is implied by 'calibration' using local healthy controls.
NM2-3.supporting_text: The normative model was generated using resting state connectivity data from approximately 22,000 healthy individuals across the lifespan (age range (yrs): 2-100). Healthy control data collected in this project were used for calibration of the normative reference curves
